meta.bit_reading_note: Part A positions run Kickoff 43's XOR_5 reuse circuit on the cell's chain: its outcome is the classical bits of circuits.XOR_5.measured_clbits in k43-reuse.json, the last listed bit first; Part B: classical bit i is the group's i-th qubit (groups)
meta.description: Kickoff 47, the wait. Part A: Kickoff 43's XOR_5 reuse circuit on chains A (144-143-142), J (143-144-145) and C (132-131-138), each without and with XY4 refocusing pulses in its idle windows, 5 interleaved copies, 10000 shots each. Part B: Ramsey (H, wait, H) and echo (H, half wait, X, half wait, H) on two groups of three qubits at six waits from 0 to 8 us, each run twice, 4000 shots each. 78 circuits, counts; the sampler's own dynamical decoupling and twirling off, as IBM recorded them.
meta.bit_order: Qiskit bitstrings, rightmost character = classical bit 0

refocusing.sequence: X, RZ(pi), X, X, RZ(pi), X (XY4 with Y = X after RZ(pi))
